title: ExplorerPatcher: free StartAllBack alternative
caption:
StartAllBack charges $4.99 to bring the Windows 10 taskbar back on Windows 11. ExplorerPatcher does it for free 🪟

✅ Windows 10 taskbar and Start menu on Windows 11
✅ Windows 10 style Alt+Tab window switcher
✅ Never combine taskbar icons, plus more tweaks
✅ Built-in updates, no subscription

💻 Windows
ℹ️ Some features may be unavailable on some Windows versions, so update it when a new Windows build lands. The installer restarts File Explorer, so save your work first. StartAllBack's $4.99 is its cheapest one-PC license

Comment "TASKBAR" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
